title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a binary-expansion helper that prints 0.1 bit by bit
body:
## Problem
Session 1 says 0.1 repeats in binary but never shows the digits.

## Context
Seeing 0.0001100110011... makes the idea concrete for beginners.

## Expected outcome
A function `binary_digits(x, n)` in `sessions/session-01/lesson.py` that returns the first n binary digits after the point, plus one test.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-01/checkpoint.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The digits of 0.5 are 1000...
- [ ] The digits of 0.1 start 0001100110011
- [ ] Checkpoint still prints PASS

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: Neumaier summation and bad orderings
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's second milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Kahan summation fails on [1, 1e100, 1, -1e100]; a small change repairs it.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add half-precision and single-precision decoding
body:
## Problem
Session 2 decodes only 64-bit floats.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 1: other number formats.

## Expected outcome
A decoder for any (exponent bits, fraction bits) layout and a check against NumPy for float16 and float32.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All 65,536 half-precision patterns match NumPy
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: three linked panels
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a number-line window, an error-growth plot and a clock counter in one tour; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Three linked panels driven by one progress value
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
